test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an example of Agro based industry of India?
solution:
The correct answer is Petrochemical.

 
• Agro-based industries are those industries that use agricultural products as raw materials. For example, cotton textiles and jute industries are agro-based industries.
 
• The agro-based industry includes industries related to textiles, sugar, paper and vegetable oil.
 
• These industries use agricultural products as raw materials.
 
• The textile industry is the largest industry in the organized sector.
 
• It comprises of
 
 
• Cotton textiles
 
• Woollen textiles
 
• Silk textiles
 
• Synthe
